sourceSentences: [0] So, I'm on to the engage support matchups. And you know, of course, if you guys play Senna, you guys know this is where this is where it's tough.
[0] Senna against engage supports is pretty hard to play.
[0] When enemy uses a spell, that's your time to go forward, go in, and like just just fight them, okay?

[0] So, when you're against an engage support, focus on baiting out the cool downs, whatever hook it might be, whatever it might be. Make sure you don't get hit by it. But once it is down, go forward. Fight. Get your souls.
[1] Senna is strongest in lanes with low kill pressure, which is typically against range supports or supports with limited range.
[1] These matchups allow you to trade freely without being heavily punished, giving you plenty of opportunities to farm souls.
[2] Senna Galio matchup. Oh, we turbo stomp.
[2] It's ah it's Synindra Senna. What? Synindra Senna. Synindra Senna is very weak.
[2] And here you just want to make sure that you push your aggro. Even if I take damage, it's fine. You just want to make sure you crash the wave.
[3] Against engage champs wait until their engage ability is down. Let's say Nautilus hook is down, okay?
[3] This is the time to go forward, get a soul on Nautilus, get a soul on the ADC. However, do not die.
[4] Very easy early, just watch out for her flash W engage, late she gets a bit more challenging.
[4] Very annoying to play vs if pyke was not in the game this would be my perma ban, no counterplay to lategame and early game/mid game is as hard.

[4] She can flash engage and kill you at level 2 once maybe, but that is all she can do. After you get 20> stacks your range is higher than her entire flash combo so it's impossible to get caught unless your positioning is really really bad.
[4] It does not counter you really, you will win lategame easily you outrange rell by far
[5] She is however incredibly immobile and only has a delayed form of CC, you can easily punish her if she is a support.
[5] Senna isn't a terribly weak laner, and scales well even before she scales infinitely, but she is still squishy and immobile so you can find winning fights later on too.

[5] If you happen to get hit by her Last Embrace, you can easily (W) Ferromancy - Crash Down out of it, but move away when one of your teammates is nearby and can get rooted by the (W) Last Embrace AoE.
